narrative: Results-oriented Software Engineer with 5 years of experience designing and scaling full-stack applications. Passionate about cloud architecture, optimizing database performance, and building resilient microservices. Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams to deliver enterprise-grade solutions that drive user engagement and reduce operational costs.

education.details: GPA: 3.8. Coursework: Distributed Systems, Data Structures, Algorithms, Cloud Computing. Capstone: Developed a predictive analytics dashboard for local public transit.

experience.bullets: Architected and migrated a monolithic REST API to a serverless AWS microservices architecture, reducing infrastructure costs by 35%, Led a team of 3 junior developers in rebuilding the primary customer portal using React and TypeScript, improving Lighthouse performance scores from 68 to 94, Implemented automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Docker, reducing deployment times by 50% and cutting production rollbacks to near zero

Developed and maintained responsive frontend components using Vue.js and Vuex, servicing over 50,000 monthly active users, Designed and optimized PostgreSQL database schemas to handle real-time IoT data ingestion, improving query speeds by 20%, Wrote comprehensive unit and integration tests using Jest and Cypress, achieving 85% code coverage across the primary application repository
Created an internal data visualization dashboard using Python, Flask, and Chart.js to track API usage metrics, Resolved 40+ bug tickets in the legacy PHP codebase during the summer internship program

projects.name: CacheFlow - Distributed Key-Value Store
projects.description: Engineered a lightweight, distributed in-memory key-value store in Go utilizing the Raft consensus algorithm for fault tolerance. Benchmarked to handle 15,000+ concurrent reads/sec. Containerized with Docker for seamless local deployment.

projects.name: DevSync Collaboration Tool
projects.description: Built a real-time collaborative code editor supporting multi-cursor editing and live chat. Implemented WebSocket connections for sub-50ms latency updates and utilized JWT for secure user authentication.

awards.name: Innovation Award - Q3 2023
awards.description: Awarded for spearheading the transition to a serverless architecture, which significantly reduced system latency during peak traffic hours.

awards.name: 1st Place - FinTech Hackathon
awards.description: Led a team of 4 to build 'SplitIt', an AI-powered receipt scanning and expense-splitting web app over a 48-hour period.

publications.title: Scaling Node.js Microservices Under Heavy Load
publications.description: A comprehensive technical breakdown of strategies for scaling Node.js applications, focusing on clustering, reverse proxies, and caching layers.

target.jobDescription: We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Core Payments team.
